images.filename: USS Barnstable County (LST-1197) in the Suez Canal 1974.jpg
images.caption: The U.S. Navy tank landing ship USS Barnstable County (LST-1197) in the Suez Canal in 1974. Barnstable County served as as flagship of the U.S. Taks Force 65 from 8 June to 8 October. TF 65 was responsible for the mine clearing operations in the Suez Canal (Operation Nimbus Star/Nimbus Moon).
images.alt: The U.S. Navy tank landing ship USS Barnstable County (LST-1197) in the Suez Canal in 1974. Barnstable County served as as flagship of the U.S. Taks Force 65 from 8 June to 8 October. TF 65 was responsible for the mine clearing operations in the Suez Canal (Operation Nimbus Star/Nimbus Moon).

images.filename: USS Iwo Jima (LPH-2) underway at sea, in 1974.jpg
images.caption: The U.S. Navy amphibious assault ship USS Iwo Jima (LPH-2) underway at sea, in 1974. Visible on deck are Bell UH-1N Twin Huey, three Bell AH-1J SeaCobra, eight Boeing-Vertol CH-46 Sea Knight of Marine Medium Helicopter Transport Squadron 261 (HMM-261) and two Sikorsky RH-53D of Mine Countermeasures Squadron 12 (HM-12). The helicopters of HM-12 were employed in the 1974 Suez Canal Clearance Operation ("Operation Nimbus Star").
images.alt: The U.S. Navy amphibious assault ship USS Iwo Jima (LPH-2) underway at sea, in 1974. Visible on deck are Bell UH-1N Twin Huey, three Bell AH-1J SeaCobra, eight Boeing-Vertol CH-46 Sea Knight of Marine Medium Helicopter Transport Squadron 261 (HMM-261) and two Sikorsky RH-53D of Mine Countermeasures Squadron 12 (HM-12). The helicopters of HM-12 were employed in the 1974 Suez Canal Clearance Operation ("Operation Nimbus Star").

images.filename: Sikorsky RH-53D Sea Stallion of HM-12 sweeping the Suez Canal, in 1974.jpg
images.caption: A U.S. Navy Sikorsky RH-53D Sea Stallion of Helicopter Mine Countermeasures Squadron 12 (HM-12) sweeping the Suez Canal, in 1974. HM-12 operated from the amphibious assault ship USS Iwo Jima (LPH-2) during the 1974 Suez Canal Clearance Operation ("Operation Nimbus Star"). Iwo Jima was later relieved by USS Inchon (LPH-12).
images.alt: A U.S. Navy Sikorsky RH-53D Sea Stallion of Helicopter Mine Countermeasures Squadron 12 (HM-12) sweeping the Suez Canal, in 1974. HM-12 operated from the amphibious assault ship USS Iwo Jima (LPH-2) during the 1974 Suez Canal Clearance Operation ("Operation Nimbus Star"). Iwo Jima was later relieved by USS Inchon (LPH-12).
